records.rationale: The docstring in get_failure_reason() (incident_occurrence.py) does contain typos ("humam readible") and includes an example output ("A failed check-in was detected") that the function cannot return (it returns one of SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP messages or the "%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected" template).
